items.claim: Mackenzie Dern is better at grappling than Gillian Robertson.
items.quote: Both of their attributes are grappling and when you stack their grappling against each other, Mackenzie's is better, obviously.

items.claim: Mackenzie Dern is a better striker than Gillian Robertson.
items.quote: I hate to say it, but I think Mackenzie is better on her feet as well.

items.claim: Gillian Robertson has improved her ground and pound under Dean Thomas.
items.quote: And Gillian does have really I'll give her her ground and pound has gotten a lot better and that's something that Dean is very big on is ground and pound.

items.claim: Ian Garry possesses very dangerous stabbing kicks.
items.quote: his skills his tools he is bro. His his stabbing kicks are very very dangerous.

items.claim: Ian Garry has good takedown defense when you wrestle him on the upper body.
items.quote: His takedown defense is good if you wrestle him on the body.

items.claim: To successfully take down Ian Garry, a wrestler must attack his legs rather than attempting upper body trips.
items.quote: You notice that round three you have to wrestle his legs... Islam can't get upper body trips he can't do it but he's not he's going to wrestle the legs.
